reasoning.stl_hierarchical_stacking_p4_sh0.2: series_profile.model_landscape.models_redundant=true AND seasonality.strength=moderate → STL decomposition-aware stacking exploits trend/seasonal component differences
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rmse_spread_ratio=0.5275 AND combination_recommendation.regularization=high → shrinkage=0.35 and top_k=4 aligns with recommended_knobs
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false AND validation_summary.best_per_horizon.unique_winners=6 → per-horizon selection captures differentiated model performance across horizons

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND n_windows=2 → ridge overfits with few training windows
